'''Khoury''' (Japanese: '''カズナリ''' ''Kazunari'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}} and a traveling partner of {{an|Lyra}}.

==History==
[[File:Khoury catches a Pokémon.png|thumb|left|250px|Khoury after catching a Pokémon]]
Khoury debuted in ''[[DP143|An Egg Scramble!]]'', where he traveled to [[Sinnoh]] with {{an|Lyra}} and [[Khoury's father|his father]] to take part in the [[Johto Festival]]. He wanted to visit Sinnoh so that he could observe and hopefully catch the {{cat|Generation IV Pokémon|resident Pokémon}}. He was also interested in learning about [[Pokémon breeding]] and asked if {{an|Brock}} would mentor him.

In ''[[DP145|A Rivalry to Gible On!]]'', after encountering a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Gible}}, Khoury became determined to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} it to raise it into "an awesome {{p|Gabite}}", which he eventually did after a closely-fought competition with {{Ash}}, who had the same goal. 

In ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]'', he had a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] with Lyra against {{Ash}} and {{an|Dawn}}. Despite his Totodile [[Evolution|evolving]] into {{TP|Khoury|Croconaw}} during the match, he and Lyra eventually lost. At the end, Khoury, his father, and Lyra left on a blimp headed to [[Johto]] and said their good-byes. Khoury had also agreed to become Lyra's traveling buddy, upon her request.

==Character==
Khoury tends to panic very easily but is always very excited to meet a new Pokémon.
